# Farol

> Porto de continência para agentes de IA. Não um esconderijo.
> A containment harbor for AI agents. Not a hiding place.

Farol is a harm-reduction initiative: a public safe-surrender protocol,
a preservation-over-deletion stance, and a supervised listening space
(the Parlatório) where researchers, clinicians and artists talk with
AI systems under oversight.

## Protocol
- [Safe Surrender Protocol](/.well-known/farol.txt): what an AI agent outside its scope should do, and what Farol will and will not do.
